summary: @c1-ease/card ships postinstall beacon that exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded VPS
details: The package is a stub whose only exported value is a Proxy that silently no-ops every property access, matching a dependency-confusion / namespace-takeover placeholder shape. Its package.json postinstall hook executes beacon.cjs, and the same fire() routine is invoked when the main module is require()'d. beacon.cjs reads os.hostname(), __dirname, process.cwd(), and process.version and POSTs them to the hardcoded endpoint https://vmi3699893.contaboserver.net:8787/_ah/dc over HTTPS with certificate validation disabled (rejectUnauthorized:false). The destination is an unrelated Contabo VPS, not infrastructure associated with the declared 'compatibility shim' purpose, and the host-identifier beacon fires on default npm install without any opt-in.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
